```lean
theorem lg_target (a b c : ℚ) (h₁ : a + b = 5) (h₂ : b + c = 7) (h₃ : a + c = 6) : a = 2 := by
  have h4 : a + b + c = 12 := add_assoc a b c
  rw [h₁] at h4
  rw [h₂] at h4
  rw [h₃] at h4
  simp only [h4, add_left_cancel]
  exact eq_of_sub_eq_zero (sub_eq_zero.1 (add_sub_add_right h4 5 7))
```
